Chapter 1102: Chapter 25: Fierce Sun Splits the Sky (Seeking Subscription)_3

The core royal family, with their ancestral bloodline nearly reaching its pinnacle, have little interest in the throne, as becoming emperor offers limited advantages in enhancing their power.

Becoming emperor certainly bestows numerous powers, yet it also comes with the burden of many trivial matters.

Swoosh.

The grand doors of the residence were opened.

An elderly servant figure emerged, bowing towards the Red Pine King and said, “Your Highness, please come inside.”

The Red Pine King entered at once and in a pavilion within the cavernous estate, he met his sixth elder brother.

The sixth elder brother of the Red Pine King was a tall man, currently sitting cross-legged, with an aura faintly circulating from within.

“Sixth Brother, I feel you have grown stronger again. Could it be that you’re about to break the Heavenly Venerate barrier and enter the Heavenly Venerate Realm?” the Red Pine King immediately flattered.

He came this time to ask a favor from his sixth brother, naturally choosing his words carefully.

“Heavenly Venerate?” The tall man shook his head. “For us royals, our success and failure lie with our bloodline, making it almost impossible to ascend to the level of a Heavenly Venerate.”

Of course, those in the core royal family who have truly cultivated to the peak of the Great Lord realm do not fear Heavenly Venerate-level powers. In fact, the abundant resources of the Ancient Country cause great dread in these Heavenly Venerates.

“So, tell me, why have you come to find me?”

The tall man looked at the Red Pine King, understanding that his brother would never say such things unless he needed something.

“Sixth Brother, as you know, I get quite bored staying in the capital, so I sought the title of a prince. Initially, I enjoyed some leisure outside, but that Spirit Might King, in his ambition to become emperor, plans to invade my Ancient Country’s lands.”

The Red Pine King continued, “Coincidentally, my fief is nearby and thus I automatically became the ruler responsible for resisting Spirit Might King’s invasion.”

“If it were just Spirit Might King, I wouldn’t fear him, but his brother…”

The Red Pine King trailed off, looking pitifully at the tall man, “Sixth Brother, I’m no match for him…”

“I see.”

The tall man nodded, “You want me to help you then?”

“Yes.”

The Red Pine King nodded immediately, “You’re the only one I can ask for help. As for the others, even if they are willing to help, they would surely extort me heavily.”

Given the pretense of defending against the invasion of a hostile Ancient Country, the Red Pine King could easily seek assistance and request a core royal Great Lord’s aid without much difficulty.

However, assistance comes at a price, as core royal Great Lords always require compensation.

This is an unwritten rule within the Ancient Country.

“Since you’ve put it this way, I’ll help you when the time comes.”

The tall man sighed, speaking with a great sense of helplessness, “But I will only intervene if Spirit Might King’s brother makes a move, otherwise I won’t.”

“Of course.”

“Without his brother’s support, who is Spirit Might King anyway?”

The Red Pine King immediately added.

…

In Qingfen City.

Lin Yuan’s true body sat in the Sky Burning Court, immersed in cultivation and understanding, while outside, he left an incarnation to facilitate exchanges with other Great Lords.

Each Great Lord had evolved their own power paths from chaos, providing Lin Yuan with significant insights.

Under normal circumstances, each Great Lord would be stationed in their territories, and even if Lin Yuan wanted to communicate with them, he wouldn’t have the opportunity.

But now? With the impending invasion of the Purple Dream Domain, nearly twenty Great Lords had gathered in Qingfen City, giving Lin Yuan the chance to interact and discuss with them anytime.

In fact, it wasn’t just Lin Yuan communicating and discussing with the Great Lords; it was the Great Lords engaging in exchanges and sparring among themselves, while Lin Yuan observed and listened quietly.

Swoosh.

Two streams of Chaos Flame constantly clashed, one exhibited two colors, scarlet and cyan, and the other exuded a sharp aura.

It was like a chaotic fire axe cleaving everything apart.

The next moment.

The sharp aura-laden Chaos Flame retreated.

“Brother Hongye’s path of combining Chaos Flame with Chaos Life seems quite close to achieving Heavenly Venerate status.”

Fire Axe Great Venerable remarked to Great Venerate Hongye with slight admiration.

He was also a peak Great Lord, focusing on annihilation through Chaos Flame, wielding it like a giant axe to obliterate everything.

Undoubtedly, Fire Axe Great Venerable excelled in destructive killing techniques among peak Great Lords.

However, during the recent sparring with Great Venerate Hongye, he found himself in a difficult position due to Hongye’s dual approach using Chaos Flame and Chaos Life.

Eventually, he had to admit defeat.

“Hahaha, Brother Fire Axe, don’t jest with me. Heavenly Venerate? I still can’t see the path to Heavenly Venerate.”

Great Venerate Hongye shook his head and said, “Besides, we were only sparring, unable to employ our true lethal techniques, which isn’t fair for you, Brother Fire Axe.”

After Hongye finished speaking.

Fire Axe Great Venerable’s expression visibly improved.

“I couldn’t employ deadly techniques, but neither did you, Brother Hongye. A loss is a loss.”

Fire Axe Great Venerable stated openly.

The other present Great Lords occasionally sparred and exchanged as well.

However, most focused their attention on Great Venerate Hongye and Fire Axe Great Venerable.

After all, these two were both at the peak of Great Lords.

Lin Yuan sat in a corner, quietly observing the clashes among the numerous Great Lords.

[Your comprehension is exceptional, witnessing the fluctuations of Chaos Flame enhances your understanding of the Chaos Flame path…]

Most Great Lords on the battleground followed the path of Chaos Flame. Occasionally, other paths flashed, but Lin Yuan focused mainly on understanding the Chaos Flame path.

At this moment.

Great Venerate Hongye, who just finished sparring with Fire Axe Great Venerable, suddenly turned his gaze to Lin Yuan.

“Yu Yan.”

Great Venerate Hongye’s tone was gentle.

The other Great Lords also looked over.

“Great Venerate Hongye.” Lin Yuan responded immediately.

“It’s been some time since you crossed into the Great Lord realm. Have you thought of your title yet?” Great Venerate Hongye asked with interest.

Generally speaking, a Great Lord would choose a title for themselves.

For instance, Great Venerate Hongye’s real name was certainly not Hongye.

It was the same for Great Venerable Qingfen.

“A title, eh.”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment, then finally said, “Let’s go with Galaxy.”
